repair.reason: no repair, durability or gold event is recorded

restock.reason: no purchase event is recorded; the belt state at each town visit is not kept

town.reason: town trips are recorded but not what triggered them (pack, belt or an order)

return.reason: the kit state when the hero left town is not recorded

tp.reason: lost portal scrolls and the walks back are not recorded

tpreserve.reason: the scroll count at each trip is not recorded

retreat.reason: the stance row previews the retreat line from recorded fights; this per-situation rule needs the situation at each retreat, which is not recorded

potionmix.reason: the belt contents and which column ran dry are not recorded

potiontier.reason: potion purchases and their prices are not recorded

belt.reason: the belt fill at each town visit is not recorded

sell.reason: no sell or gold event is recorded, so what would have been sold cannot be counted (the white pickups of the loot row are previewed instead)

identify.reason: identify scrolls used and unidentified items carried are not recorded

stash.reason: stash fullness and gold deposits are not recorded

questhints.reason: hints only speak; no recorded event shows what a hint changed
